timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit UTC offset, used for auditable repository timestamps.

date.description: ISO 8601 full calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

source_id.description: Human-readable immutable Source Registry identifier following docs/SOURCE_REFERENCE.md.

field_id.description: Permanent immutable Field Registry identifier; it never changes when canonical or display names evolve.

source_ids.description: Non-empty deduplicated Source Registry IDs providing provenance for a record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence confidence from 1 (unverified/speculative) through 5 (verified SEC filing).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the represented entity or repository record; unknown means evidence is insufficient.

notes.description: Optional factual or methodological clarification; null means none is recorded.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter uppercase currency code for an adjacent monetary value.

percentage.description: Decimal fraction from 0 through 1, where 0.25 represents 25 percent.

uuid.description: Canonical RFC 4122 UUID string used as an immutable entity or relationship identifier.

fact_value_classification.description: How a Fact value was produced; this classification is immutable after creation.

fact_verification_status.description: Current review conclusion for a Fact, independent of production method and lifecycle.

fact_lifecycle_status.description: Administrative lifecycle of a Fact; historical Facts remain stored in every state.

fact_value_type.description: Discriminator selecting the exact JSON representation and format of observed_value.

semantic_category.description: Controlled semantic behavior or subject-matter category assigned to a governed Field.

entity_record_status.description: Repository-management state of a structural entity record, not the operating status of the real-world subject.

source_type.description: Controlled evidence-medium classification for a Source Registry record.

entity_type.description: Canonical entity collection to which a Fact applies.

storage_provider.description: Provider holding immutable source bytes outside GitHub; none means no archived copy exists.

hash_algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to verify externally archived source bytes.
